investigation_notes.Data Sensitivity: Payroll and financial documents (sample files include payroll, invoices, and tax documents)
investigation_notes.Evidence Volume: 305 files downloaded versus 28 in the prior 24 hours
investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (305) was observed for user acc@globalcorp.ee, significantly above the 24-hour baseline of 28. The downloads target payroll and financial documents within the Finland HR site, with the operation performed via Mepco MSGraph from Tampere, Finland. The destination is an external IP (40.108.201.15), suggesting potential data exfiltration or automated bulk retrieval. Given the sensitivity of the data, the anomalous volume, external destination, and timing within working hours, this alert is classified as High Priority and warrants immediate investigation.
